statusDefinitions.NOT_STARTED: No usable processing implementation is present.
statusDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED: Some real functionality exists, but required output, integration, browser, privacy, or boundary evidence is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_WITH_EVIDENCE: No validated in-browser engine or safe implementation is currently available in this repository.
statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Real supported behavior and required output, integration, browser, security, and privacy tests all pass.

validation.focusedResult: 27 tests passed: six qpdf helper tests, three compression worker-service tests, and 18 PDF tools component/service tests.
validation.fullSuiteResult: 179 tests passed, 0 failed. An earlier run had a transient timeout in the PDF.js selectable-text export/comparison test; the isolated 18-test PDF tools spec and final full rerun both passed.
validation.buildResult: Passed after adding PDF compression and text overlays; prerendered 7 static routes. The non-blocking pako CommonJS optimization warning remains.
validation.privacyNetworkTests: Manual production-browser traces for Protect PDF and Compress PDF observed only same-origin GETs for worker bundles and qpdf.wasm; no document POST. Other tools were not traced, and no repeatable browser E2E/network-interception suite is configured.
validation.dependencyAudit: npm.cmd audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate found 10 production advisories (6 high, 4 moderate). A subsequent full-tree audit reported 49 total advisories (2 critical, 30 high, 14 moderate, 3 low).

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.unitTest: Six qpdf helper tests, three worker-service tests, and the 179-test full suite pass.
tools.outputValidation: Production browser compressed a valid 30,800-byte, 250-page fixture to 2,699 bytes; qpdf checks the output before delivery. If compression does not reduce size, the original is retained.
tools.privacyTest: Manual production-browser request trace observed only same-origin GETs for the worker bundle and qpdf.wasm; no document POST or API fallback.
tools.limitations: Lossless structural/Flate compression only; does not recompress image formats. Maximum 20 MB; encrypted PDFs must first be unlocked. Some PDFs will not become smaller.

tools.name: Unlock PDF
tools.unitTest: Covered in the pre-existing test suite; controlled encrypted-fixture coverage and current focused count were not separately collected in this run.
tools.outputValidation: Partial; encrypted fixture and wrong-password behavior need explicit regression evidence.
tools.privacyTest: Source uses a same-tab worker and static WASM download; no automated browser network interception was run.
tools.limitations: Requires the current password; not a password recovery/cracking tool.

tools.name: Protect PDF
tools.unitTest: Three qpdf helper tests and four worker-service tests pass; full suite passes 179 tests.
tools.outputValidation: Production browser generated a 1,670-byte AES-256 PDF; local qpdf round-trip rejected a wrong password, accepted the correct password, decrypted the output, and reopened the resulting one-page PDF.
tools.privacyTest: Manual production-browser request trace observed only GETs for the same-origin worker bundle and qpdf.wasm; no PDF/password POST or API fallback.
tools.limitations: Maximum 20 MB; requires distinct 8–127 printable-ASCII open and owner passwords; already-encrypted PDFs must first be unlocked. Browser/network evidence is manual, not an automated E2E test.
